title: Virtual Volleyball
native_title: バーチャル・バレーボール
overview:
The world's 8 powerhouse teams have gathered here to decide the strongest champion.

Real-time polygon calculation recreates a wide variety of combinations and dynamic play.

Virtual Volleyball is an indoor volleyball game played with fully polygonal players and courts. Pick one of eight national teams and handle every touch of a rally - receive, toss and spike - using quick combination attacks to beat the block on the other side of the net.

- Team data screens list every player on the roster with ratings, serve type and court role
- Instant replays of big plays
- 1 to 8 players (additional control pads required)
- Memory backup

世界の強豪8チームが、最強王者をきめるためここに集結した。

リアルタイムポリゴン演算により多彩なコンビネーション、ダイナミックなプレイを再現。
